| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rolling Launch | `rollingLaunchEnabled` | choice |  | Hold a captured RPM window while moving with the activation switch or Lua trigger held. |
| Activation switch pin | `rollingLaunchActivatePin` | choice |  | Hardware activation switch, OR-ed with setRollingLaunchTrigger(1). Unassigned allows Lua-only activation. https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~switch_inputs |
| Switch pin mode | `rollingLaunchActivatePinMode` | choice |  |  |
| Min vehicle speed to arm | `rollingLaunchMinVss` | {bitStringValue(velocityUnitsLabels | 0 … 0 | Minimum vehicle speed while the trigger is held. Requires valid vehicle speed. |
| Min RPM to arm | `rollingLaunchMinArmRpm` | rpm | 0 … 15000 | Minimum RPM while the trigger is held. Crossing this gate can arm without another button press. |
| RPM window above capture | `rollingLaunchRpmWindow` | rpm | 0 … 4000 | RPM above the captured arming RPM where spark skip reaches 100%. Zero requests a hard cut at the captured RPM. |
| Max RPM ceiling (clamp) | `rollingLaunchMaxRpm` | rpm | 0 … 15000 | Maximum captured target RPM. The normal rev limiter remains independent. |
| Timing retard while held | `rollingLaunchTimingRetard` | deg | 0 … 30 | Ignition timing removed while armed. This is relative retard, not an absolute timing target. |
| Fuel adder while held | `rollingLaunchFuelAdderPercent` | % | 0 … 50 | Additional fuel while armed. Removed immediately when disarmed. |
| Ramp-out time on release | `rollingLaunchRampOutTime` | s | 0 … 10 | Time for the timing retard to decay to zero after release or loss of an arming gate. Zero removes retard immediately. |
